files.README.md:
# milk intake journal

Rushmere Dairy's intake bay records every tanker it unloads in logs/intake.log:

    <time> TANKER farm=<id> litres=<n>

The intake equipment stamps its lines on the dairy's own clock, which runs
three hours ahead of UTC. The journal holds one day of intake and is closed
with a line whose count covers every tanker line above it.
